caption: The drawing depicts a stone wall niche containing a fountain basin supported by a single rounded column. The structure is made from beige and light brown stone, showing various textures and shades, indicating weathering and age. The niche is topped with an arched recess, outlined by multiple concentric moldings. In the center of the niche above the basin, a small round metal spout is set into the stone, which would dispense water into the shallow, semi-circular basin below. The basin itself rests on a classic cylindrical pedestal, which stands on a square base with circular steps. The stone blocks comprising the wall and arch have rough, uneven edges, adding to the sense of antiquity. The entire composition is centrally aligned against a plain, off-white background, with the artist's signature, "Rose Campbell-Clarke," written at the bottom right.
title: Lavabo
